@UNCX_token Smart Token Vesting was drained of five ERC-20s worth ≈$87.7K at parent-block spot prices. 

The exploit contract retained ≈$85.6K in EDGEN, ZC, PEPECOIN, LO0P and PAAL; after 0.5624 ETH in fees/gas, estimated mark-to-market profit was ≈$84.2K.

VestingManager.release() subtracts claimed shares from global _totalTokenShares but leaves them in the position's _depositedShares.

so already-released shares are removed from the global total a second time. 

The attacker used a direct donation to magnify this stale-share debit, 

corrupted the denominator, then released a second attacker-owned vesting to take tokens backing unrelated users.

VestingManager.release() subtracts claimed shares from global _totalTokenShares but leaves them in the position's _depositedShares.

The attacker used a direct donation to magnify this stale-share debit,
